metadata.title: Shavari City Battle
metadata.sourceGame: Shavari Chess on the Hikoro website

movementSemantics.step: The destination and every intermediate square must be clear; a building or unit blocks the path.
movementSemantics.jump: Intermediate squares may contain units; the destination cannot be a building. Capture is allowed only when that rule's capture flag is true.
movementSemantics.ray: Moves one square at a time in the listed direction; buildings and units stop the ray. A capturable enemy at the first occupied square may be captured, then the ray ends.
movementSemantics.captureFlag: Each step, jump, or ray has its own capture boolean. Friendly units cannot be captured.
movementSemantics.opponentVectors: Apply orientation.oppositeCourtTransform to movement vectors for Turquoise.
